styles.N: Speak naturally, like a real person explaining something to a colleague: relaxed and warm, conversational rhythm, small natural pauses, gentle emphasis on the key words. Not an announcer, not a commercial. Say only the words after the colon:
styles.H: Speak naturally, like a real senior anaesthesiologist answering a question in a quiet interview: relaxed, sincere, conversational, with a small thoughtful pause. Not read aloud, not acted. Say only the words after the colon:
styles.U: Speak naturally, like a real experienced surgeon answering a question in a quiet interview: calm, sincere, conversational, slightly understated. Not read aloud, not acted. Say only the words after the colon:
styles.K: Speak naturally, like a real head of anaesthesiology talking candidly on a phone call: calm, practical, matter-of-fact, conversational. Not read aloud, not acted. Say only the words after the colon:

lines.text: Eight German letters. One patient.
Two minutes to find what matters before surgery. Meet TORU.
lines.say: Two minutes to find what matters before surgery. Meet Toru.

lines.text: Blood thinners, allergies, heart function. I can see everything, and also where it came from, which is nice.
In TORU, enter the patient, then the task.
lines.say: In Toru, enter the patient, then the task.

lines.text: Two seconds later: one screen.
Contradictions on the left. What the task needs, in the centre. The original letters, on the right.
For example: allergies, blood thinner, airway and heart function come first.
EF sixty percent. Where from? One click shows the exact sentence in the original letter.
The records disagree: left or right carotid? Both sources, side by side.
Missing information is explicit: previous anaesthesia, not documented.
Browse every letter by date, or every fact by type.
I don't have to trust a summary. I read the original myself.
Change the role: the GP gets diabetes drugs, HbA1c and a weight loss.
TORU is not a mock-up. It has a working backend. Names removed before any AI call, data encrypted.
lines.say: Toru is not a mock-up: a working backend. Names removed before any AI call, data encrypted.

lines.text: We tested TORU end to end on the running system: fifteen of fifteen correct.
lines.say: We tested Toru end to end on the running system: fifteen of fifteen correct.

lines.text: One AI call with the whole record: six. Simple rules: eight.
Zero false alarms. Every fact traceable, none invented. Typical answer: under two seconds.
lines.say: Zero false alarms. Every fact traceable, none invented. Typical answer: under two seconds.

lines.text: Why an LLM? On unseen requests, it lifts complete checklists from half to two thirds.
lines.say: Why an LLM? On unseen requests, it lifts complete checklists from half to two thirds.

lines.text: Not working yet: thirteen percent of unusual requests still miss an item. And there is no FHIR link.
lines.say: Not working yet: thirteen percent of unusual requests still miss an item. And there is no FHIR link.

lines.text: Seeing only relevant info is useful. It just needs to be nicely ordered, so we don't get lost.
Doctors in Austria, Slovakia and Switzerland tried TORU, and want it. Next: a supervised pilot.
lines.say: Doctors in Austria, Slovakia and Switzerland tried Toru, and want it. Next: a supervised pilot.
